{{Short description|Scottish medical statistician}}
{{EngvarB|date=June 2025}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=June 2025}}
'''Marion Kay Campbell'''<ref>{{Cite web |last=Cuthbertson |first=B. |last2=Campbell |first2=Marion Kay |last3=Stott |first3=S. |last4=Vale |first4=Luke David |last5=Norrie |first5=John David Taylor |last6=Kinsella |first6=J. |last7=Cook |first7=Jonathan Alistair |last8=Brittenden |first8=Julie |last9=Grant |first9=Adrian Maxwell |year=2010 |title=Pragmatic multi-centre randomised trial of (1) routine postoperative ICU care and/or (2) pre-operative fluid loading in high-risk surgical patients undergoing major elective and urgent surgery |url=https://abdn.elsevierpure.com/en/publications/pragmatic-multi-centre-randomised-trial-of-1-routine-postoperativ |access-date=2024-05-24 |website=University of Aberdeen |language=English}}</ref> is a Scottish medical statistician, clinical trialist, and academic administrator who is the dean of research for life sciences and medicine and a professor of [[health services research]] at the [[University of Aberdeen]].

== Life ==
Campbell completed a BSc in statistics with honours, a MSc in statistics, and a PhD in public health from the [[University of Aberdeen]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Professor Marion Campbell {{!}} Health Services Research Unit {{!}} The University of Aberdeen |url=https://www.abdn.ac.uk/hsru/who-we-are/people/profiles/m.k.campbell |access-date=2024-04-13 |website=www.abdn.ac.uk |language=en-GB}}</ref>

Campbell worked in [[Operations research|operational research]] and the statistics of [[medical audit]]s at the [[National Health Service]].<ref name=":0" /> In 1993, she returned to her alma mater, the University of Aberdeen where she works in the [[health services research]] unit.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Leading professor elected to prestigious medical sciences fellowship {{!}} News {{!}} The University of Aberdeen |url=https://www.abdn.ac.uk/news/17021/ |access-date=2024-04-13 |website=www.abdn.ac.uk}}</ref> She is a [[Medical statistics|medical statistician]] and clinical trialist who serves as a professor of health services research.<ref name=":0" /> In 2007, she became the director of the unit and dean of research for life sciences and medicine in 2015.<ref name=":1" /> As of 2023, she is the vice principal for research. Campbell is a fellow of the [[Academy of Medical Sciences (United Kingdom)|Academy of Medical Sciences]] (2023) and the [[Royal Society of Edinburgh]].<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" />
